english.note: Use this colloquial metaphor for carrying on with tasks mechanically without consciously thinking about them, not for an actual vehicle-control system.

examples.english: When I got home from work, I realized I'd been on autopilot all evening.
examples.traditional: 我放工返到屋企先發現自己成晚都係自動波。
